notes:
What's new in 0.1.78:
• Converted films start faster the second time. When this computer converts a film for a phone or TV, it now keeps the converted copy and reuses it next time. Old copies are cleared automatically when the conversion folder reaches its size limit. Only Beebo's own conversion folder is ever cleaned; your films are never touched.
• New "Faster / Balanced / Better quality" choice. Settings > Playback lets you choose how hard this computer works when it converts a film. Balanced is the same as before.
• Smaller downloads use your graphics chip. When you have graphics-chip decoding switched on, preparing a smaller download for a phone uses it too.
• Text subtitles can be burnt into the picture. For players that cannot show subtitles on their own, normal text subtitles can now be drawn into the picture, in your chosen subtitle style, when this computer's converter supports it.
• Live TV can use your graphics chip and keep surround sound. Live TV now uses graphics-chip decoding when it is switched on, and keeps 5.1 sound for devices that can play it (others get stereo as before).
• Your saved settings are no longer reset by mistake. Several settings screens could quietly put back the defaults when you pressed Save: Live TV recording times and format, parental-control presets (which could unblock titles you had blocked), your own relay account ID, e-mail and search-site settings, sign-in limits and the backup "keep" number. All of these now keep what you saved.
• Parental presets for Canadian film ratings. If a profile uses the Canadian rating scale, the presets now use Canadian ratings and keep the Canadian scale. TV limits are unchanged.
• Camera RAW photos in Beebo Inbox. Canon, Nikon, Sony, Olympus and Fuji RAW photos (CR2, NEF, ARW, ORF, RAF) are now recognised by Beebo Inbox. It still never deletes or overwrites your files.
• Better matching for oddly named films. If a film's file name uses numbers in place of letters and no match is found, Beebo now tries a decoded spelling as a second guess and marks the result as probable. Your files are never renamed.
• Security fixes. A paired TV or browser viewer can now only use the screens for watching, never owner settings or accounts. Live TV no longer accepts network folder paths sent from another device. Uploads with an unsafe or non-video file name are refused straight away. The app's pages now enforce stricter content rules.
• Easier to read in light themes. The Home layouts, Command Deck, Layout Share and 18 other screens were hard to read with a light theme. They now have readable text. The default dark look is unchanged.
• Clearer messages when something fails. Radio, Podcasts and Playlists now say what went wrong instead of doing nothing.
• Get Started screen tidied. The first-run steps now match the current app.
• Smaller app code. The app's own program code is packed more tightly inside the installer.
• The installer is not code-signed.
• Built from commit 702f2b57, Oct 4, 2026, 10:02 PM Eastern.
